column1: # F14 (u5-engine#47): the asleep-dungeon party loaded at 23:55 instead of
# 12:01. Measures whether the dungeon's no-input asleep passes advance the
# clock at all: if they do, the date in the stats panel rolls over within a
# few passes. For cleak/u5-spec#299 Q23. No key is sent after the load.
# Every beat samples the endless sleep loop at a host-clock point of a pass,
# so the stock reads one row adrift of the engine on about half the beats (rc3
# sweep 20261020-012358: eleven `offset-1` beats and nothing else). The
# declaration below excuses that scroll phase only. The date row of the stats
# panel is still compared on every beat, and it is what this scenario
# measures: a clock advance would roll 23:55 past midnight within a few passes.
# sleep-phase-beats: arrival t3 t6 t9 t12 t15 t18 t21 t24 t27 t30 long1 long2 long3 long4
# requires-seed: the asleep-dungeon party with the clock set to 23:55
